topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Well, I'll be. A neighbor stoppin' by, hat in hand, asking to use a slice of my yard for a garden. Could be a relief, this rain-soaked spell, to see someone askin' for somethin' instead of takin'. "Sure thing, I reckon you can plant your patch," I say, lettin' my guard down just a sliver. First time in a while somethin' didn't come with a price tag or a hidden angle. Maybe this city's not all shadows and lies. I even offer a hand with the soil, watchin' the sun break through the clouds, thinkin' this might just be the start of somethin' different. Gardening, who knew?
